scope: Repin @hraness/algal from the pre-squash contract commit 9922202a2da45bb1f7e0db82c0be5a1c6770c21b to the merged main commit 0f73388df2093c52291687a9fccb6d170bdf2928. The tree content is identical; only the referenced commit identity changes.
motivation: The host-contract PR merged with a squashed commit SHA; the dependency pin should name the commit that actually exists on algal main so installs resolve the merged ref.

design.pin: package.json and bun.lock move the github pin to the merged commit; no source, contract or behavior change.
design.admission: The XCB reviewed-source receipt is rebound because package.json and bun.lock are inventory sources; the other 43 source hashes are unchanged.

independentReview.method: Implementer self-review of the full diff only.

limitations: This is a commit-identity repin with reviewed source composition evidence, not a live provider qualification, release signature or proof of message delivery.
